heading: About Us
intro: Explore Roots is a local driver-driven car rental and travel service helping travellers explore their destinations comfortably and conveniently.
With experienced drivers and multiple vehicle options, our goal is simple — make your journey comfortable, straightforward and dependable.

images.alt: Two Explore Roots vehicles parked on a hill road during a trip
Explore Roots cabs lined up and ready for the day's bookings

points.label: Driver-Driven Travel
points.detail: Every booking comes with a driver who has run the route before.

points.label: Multiple Vehicle Options
points.detail: Sedans, SUVs and tempo travellers for any group size.

points.label: Local Travel Knowledge
points.detail: Stops, permits and timings planned by people who live here.

points.label: Flexible Travel
points.detail: Hourly, full-day or multi-day — change plans mid-trip if you need to.

points.label: Direct WhatsApp Assistance
points.detail: One number for booking, changes and help on the road.
